# Generated by ppc finalize (location_profiles.py) from the buildings and the plan list; do not edit by hand.

# ---- Targets (location scope, in a plan's turn; scope:pp_lprof_pb = the payback limit + 100, far away for a plan) ----
# A level under construction of any of the target's buildings here: the plan waits (pp_lprof_st 103). Else a
# standing older tier whose successor (one of the target's buildings) the country has researched is upgraded
# first, one level a turn (pp_lprof_upgrade: the game's Upgrade button; the tiers follow as they unlock); then a
# standing one grows, highest tier first; where none stands, the cheapest that can be built here starts. Each
# candidate that fails ranks its reason in pp_lprof_fail (pp_lprof_finish turns it into the plan's state).

pp_lprof_t_camels = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_levels_under_construction > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:camel_stud building_type = building_type:camel_herders } } }
		set_variable = { name = pp_lprof_st value = 103 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_buildings_in_location = { building_level > 0 OR = { building_type = building_type:camel_stud building_type = building_type:camel_herders } } }
		pp_lprof_upgrade = { old = camel_herders type = camel_stud demand = workshop_construction cat = std ipl = 0.08 est = pp_cplan_bz_est_camel_stud hasest = yes }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = camel_stud demand = workshop_construction cat = std ipl = 0.08 pt = laborers sz = 1.25 lc = yes }
		pp_lprof_expand = { type = camel_herders demand = basic_construction_needs cat = std ipl = 0.08 pt = laborers sz = 1.25 lc = yes }
	}
	else = {
		pp_lprof_start = { type = camel_stud demand = workshop_construction cat = std ipl = 0.08 pt = laborers sz = 1.25 est = pp_cplan_bz_est_camel_stud hasest = yes }
		pp_lprof_start = { type = camel_herders demand = basic_construction_needs cat = std ipl = 0.08 pt = laborers sz = 1.25 est = pp_cplan_bz_est_camel_herders hasest = yes }
		pp_lprof_start_pick = yes
	}
}

# Location scope (in pp_lplan_location_turn, pp_location_profiles.txt): each held plan in the plans' order
# (pp_lplan_mark, has_town_rights: its target pp_lprof_t_<target>, or pp_tplan_do_<plan> where it raises the rank
# first; no payback limit, no market limit). Run twice a turn: once to measure (scope:pp_lplan_mode 1: the plan
# whose next level pays back soonest is built first), once to build and to write the states. The first
# construction of the turn in the location makes the rest wait. The window's ledger shows a plan's construction as
# the Locations group's, step 0.

# go only where such a plan exists (scope:pp_lplan_from above 100; else every plan ran in the first go).
